leadText:
Fight in a Cold Climate (Japanese: VS バニプッチ VS Vanillite), titled VS Vanillite in the Shogakukan Asia translation, is the 491st chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga, and the 31st chapter of the .

It is subtitled Vanillite (Japanese: 冷凍 Freezing) in the VIZ Media translation and Fight in a Cold Climate in the Shogakukan Asia translation.
